{{Top}}
A '''biologist''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who studied life and living organisms. [[Demagol]], who was noted for his research into the source of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Force power/Legends|powers]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]], was by [[3964 BBY]] noted as the top [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] biologist.

The [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Hallem Celaar]] was a biologist that assisted in [[Colonization of Ohma-D'un/Legends|developing]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]] colony. He was the head of a project to determine the viability of transplanting [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Plant/Legends|plants]] and animals to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="PotI">{{GamerCite|1|Peril in the Ionosphere}}</ref>
